<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：ドッキング・ベイ327</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライトサイド：2フォース消費して、ここから他のドッキング・ベイへ移動できる。ダークサイド：フォースを消費せずに、ここから他のドッキング・ベイへ移動できる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-285o-Video.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark) (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Death-Star-Docking-Bay-327-Dark-C1G.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja"></span>''<ref name="jp1-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: Docking Bay 327.

'''Card text:''' Light Side: Use 2 Force to move from here to another docking bay. Dark Side: Move from here to another docking bay for 0 Force.

'''Lore:'''
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark)]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
